text: Did you remember to lock the car?
ir: (ynq (e1 remember :tense past :subj (m1 you :pron) :xcomp (e2 lock :obj (m2 car :det the))))

text: Can your sister drive us to the airport tomorrow?
ir: (ynq (e1 drive :mod can :subj (m1 sister :poss (m2 you :pron)) :obj (m3 we :pron) :obl-to (m4 airport :det the) :adv tomorrow))

text: Is the pharmacy open on Sundays?
ir: (ynq (e1 be :tense pres :subj (m1 pharmacy :det the) :attr open :obl-on (m2 Sunday :num pl :propn)))
notes: Day names treated as proper names (:propn) with :num pl.

text: Have you finished your homework yet?
ir: (ynq (e1 finish :tense pres :aspect perf :subj (m1 you :pron) :obj (m2 homework :poss (m3 you :pron)) :adv yet))

text: Didn't you see the email from Priya?
ir: (ynq (e1 see :tense past :pol neg :subj (m1 you :pron) :obj (m2 email :det the :obl-from (m3 Priya :propn))))
notes: Negative question: :pol neg kept literally. PP "from Priya" attached to the noun (the only natural reading).

text: Could you close the window, please?
ir: (ynq (e1 close :mod could :subj (m1 you :pron) :obj (m2 window :det the) :adv please))
notes: Indirect request annotated literally as ynq with :mod could (§2).

text: Are the kids sleeping already?
ir: (ynq (e1 sleep :tense pres :aspect prog :subj (m1 kid :det the :num pl) :adv already))

text: Will the meeting start on time?
ir: (ynq (e1 start :tense fut :subj (m1 meeting :det the) :obl-on (m2 time)))
notes: Idiom "on time" kept as a literal :obl-on PP.

text: Should I bring anything to the party?
ir: (ynq (e1 bring :mod should :subj (m1 I :pron) :obj (m2 anything) :obl-to (m3 party :det the)))
notes: "anything" annotated as a head noun with no det.

text: Does this bus stop near the train station?
ir: (ynq (e1 stop :tense pres :subj (m1 bus :det this) :obl-near (m2 station :det the :compound train)))

text: Has the plumber called back about the leak?
ir: (ynq (e1 call :tense pres :aspect perf :subj (m1 plumber :det the) :obl-about (m2 leak :det the) :adv back))
notes: Particle "back" annotated as :adv (no particle role in v0).

text: Was the restaurant busy yesterday?
ir: (ynq (e1 be :tense past :subj (m1 restaurant :det the) :attr busy :adv yesterday))

text: Isn't Marco coming to dinner tonight?
ir: (ynq (e1 come :tense pres :aspect prog :pol neg :subj (m1 Marco :propn) :obl-to (m2 dinner) :adv tonight))

text: Would you like a cup of tea?
ir: (ynq (e1 like :mod would :subj (m1 you :pron) :obj (m2 cup :det a :obl-of (m3 tea))))
notes: Offer annotated literally as ynq with :mod would.

text: Had they already left when you arrived?
ir: (ynq (e1 leave :tense past :aspect perf :subj (m1 they :pron :ref none) :adv already :when (e2 arrive :tense past :subj (m2 you :pron))))

text: Can't you find your glasses?
ir: (ynq (e1 find :pol neg :mod can :subj (m1 you :pron) :obj (m2 glass :num pl :poss (m3 you :pron))))

text: Do your parents still live in Ohio?
ir: (ynq (e1 live :tense pres :subj (m1 parent :num pl :poss (m2 you :pron)) :obl-in (m3 Ohio :propn) :adv still))

text: Has it been raining since Tuesday?
ir: (ynq (e1 rain :tense pres :aspect perfprog :subj (m1 it :pron :ref none) :obl-since (m2 Tuesday :propn)))

text: May I borrow your umbrella?
ir: (ynq (e1 borrow :mod may :subj (m1 I :pron) :obj (m2 umbrella :poss (m3 you :pron))))

text: Is there a problem with the office printer?
ir: (ynq (e1 be :tense pres :there :subj (m1 problem :det a :obl-with (m2 printer :det the :compound office))))
notes: "with the office printer" attached to the noun "problem"."with the printer" attached to the noun "problem".

text: Who ate the last slice of pizza?
ir: (whq (e1 eat :tense past :subj (m1 who :wh) :obj (m2 slice :det the :adj last :obl-of (m3 pizza))))

text: What did you buy at the market?
ir: (whq (e1 buy :tense past :subj (m1 you :pron) :obj (m2 what :wh) :obl-at (m3 market :det the)))

text: Who did you talk to at the party?
ir: (whq (e1 talk :tense past :subj (m1 you :pron) :obl-to (m2 who :wh) :obl-at (m3 party :det the)))
notes: Stranded preposition: the wh-word is the object of "to", so :obl-to (who :wh).

text: Which train goes to the airport?
ir: (whq (e1 go :tense pres :subj (m1 train :det which :wh) :obl-to (m2 airport :det the)))

text: Where did you park the car?
ir: (whq (e1 park :tense past :subj (m1 you :pron) :obj (m2 car :det the) :wh-adv where))

text: When does the bakery open on Saturdays?
ir: (whq (e1 open :tense pres :subj (m1 bakery :det the) :obl-on (m2 Saturday :num pl :propn) :wh-adv when))

text: Why is the baby crying?
ir: (whq (e1 cry :tense pres :aspect prog :subj (m1 baby :det the) :wh-adv why))

text: How did you fix the dishwasher?
ir: (whq (e1 fix :tense past :subj (m1 you :pron) :obj (m2 dishwasher :det the) :wh-adv how))

text: What happened to your bike?
ir: (whq (e1 happen :tense past :subj (m1 what :wh) :obl-to (m2 bike :poss (m3 you :pron))))

text: Who is your new manager?
ir: (whq (e1 be :tense pres :subj (m1 who :wh) :attr (m2 manager :poss (m3 you :pron) :adj new)))
notes: Copular wh-question: spec is silent on whether "who" or the post-verbal NP is :subj. Followed the synthetic-data convention ("Who was a guest?" = :subj who). Annotating who as :attr makes the realizer output "Who is your new manager who?".

text: Which jacket should I wear tonight?
ir: (whq (e1 wear :mod should :subj (m1 I :pron) :obj (m2 jacket :det which :wh) :adv tonight))

text: Who was the package delivered to?
ir: (whq (e1 deliver :tense past :voice pass :subj (m1 package :det the) :obl-to (m2 who :wh)))

text: What are you cooking for dinner?
ir: (whq (e1 cook :tense pres :aspect prog :subj (m1 you :pron) :obj (m2 what :wh) :obl-for (m3 dinner)))

text: Where have you been hiding the cookies?
ir: (whq (e1 hide :tense pres :aspect perfprog :subj (m1 you :pron) :obj (m2 cookie :det the :num pl) :wh-adv where))

text: Why didn't Sam call me back?
ir: (whq (e1 call :tense past :pol neg :subj (m1 Sam :propn) :obj (m2 I :pron) :adv back :wh-adv why))

text: Close the door behind you.
ir: (command (e1 close :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :obj (m2 door :det the) :obl-behind (m3 you :pron)))
notes: Non-reflexive "you" in the PP is a separate (deictic) mention from the implicit subject.

text: Don't touch the stove.
ir: (command (e1 touch :pol neg :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :obj (m2 stove :det the)))

text: Please leave your shoes by the door.
ir: (command (e1 leave :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :obj (m2 shoe :num pl :poss (m3 you :pron)) :obl-by (m4 door :det the) :adv please))

text: Turn left at the next corner.
ir: (command (e1 turn :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :obl-at (m2 corner :det the :adj next) :adv left))

text: Don't forget to water the plants.
ir: (command (e1 forget :pol neg :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :xcomp (e2 water :obj (m2 plant :det the :num pl))))

text: Send me the report by Friday.
ir: (command (e1 send :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :iobj (m2 I :pron) :obj (m3 report :det the) :obl-by (m4 Friday :propn)))

text: Never feed the dog chocolate.
ir: (command (e1 feed :pol neg :negword never :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :iobj (m2 dog :det the) :obj (m3 chocolate)))

text: Please call your grandmother tomorrow.
ir: (command (e1 call :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :obj (m2 grandmother :poss (m3 you :pron)) :adv please :adv tomorrow))

text: Wash your hands before dinner.
ir: (command (e1 wash :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :obj (m2 hand :num pl :poss (m3 you :pron)) :obl-before (m4 dinner)))
notes: "before dinner" is a PP (no clause), so :obl-before rather than :before.

text: Put the milk back in the fridge.
ir: (command (e1 put :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :obj (m2 milk :det the) :obl-in (m3 fridge :det the) :adv back))

text: Don't worry about the money.
ir: (command (e1 worry :pol neg :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :obl-about (m2 money :det the)))

text: Be careful on the stairs.
ir: (command (e1 be :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :attr careful :obl-on (m2 stair :det the :num pl)))

text: Give the keys to Daniel when he arrives.
ir: (command (e1 give :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :obj (m2 key :det the :num pl) :obl-to (m3 Daniel :propn) :when (e2 arrive :tense pres :subj (m4 he :pron :ref m3))))
notes: "he" can only be Daniel (keys are plural non-human; implicit you is 2nd person).

text: Please don't park in front of the garage.
ir: (command (e1 park :pol neg :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :obl-in_front_of (m2 garage :det the) :adv please))
notes: Complex preposition "in front of" written as obl-in_front_of (cf. obl-next_to, §1).

text: Try to get some sleep.
ir: (command (e1 try :subj (m1 you :pron :implicit) :xcomp (e2 get :obj (m2 sleep :det some))))
